title: Korevix's Resources
description: Overhauls Minecraft's Resources like diamonds to a more modernized version
body:
![Showcase of textures for v1.0](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/5a8bf260b9bbf3f407464e91958339d82083a45f_0.webp)

This texture pack builds on the Vanilla textures without changing so much about them to the point they are unrecognizable.

It is also a follow-up pack to my other Texture Pack, known as Korevix's Tools

Current Reworks:

- Amethyst Shard
- Charcoal
- Coal
- Copper Ingot
- Diamond
- Emerald
- Gold Ingot
- Gold Nugget
- Iron Ingot
- Iron Nugget
- Lapis Lazuli
- Netherite Ingot
- Netherite Scrap
- Raw Copper
- Raw Gold
- Raw Iron
- Redstone Dust

I would like to know what the community thinks about this, so I enabled comments this time.

Content creators/modpack creators, you are free to use this texture pack in whatever you do. Credit is not required, but it would be nice. If done on YouTube, just include a "@KorevixVayleen" somewhere in the description. And for modpack creators, you can just put my name somewhere in the description.
